question: What is TSLPatcher used for in KOTOR modding?
answer:
TSLPatcher is the standard patcher for KotOR and TSL mods: it applies 2DA, GFF, TLK, and related table edits so installers can ship incremental changes without replacing whole game archives [1]. Mod authors use it to list file targets, row changes, and conflict-safe install order on Deadly Stream and similar hubs [2].

Sources
[1] https://deadlystream.com/files/file/1252-tslpatcher/
[2] https://kotor.neocities.org/tutorials/tslpatcher
